claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a time of approximately 01:00 (1:00 AM), not 1045 hours (10:45 AM).

claims.claim_text: Location: Trask Avenue near Magnolia Street, Westminster, CA
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the location as an alleyway and parking lot near a T-Mobile store, not Trask Avenue near Magnolia Street.

claims.evidence_observations: The video shows Officer Doan and Officer Dam, but the claim states Officer V. Phan and Officer L. Gutierrez. The names and badge numbers do not match, indicating a potential conflict.

claims.claim_text: Witness(es): Multiple witnesses at commercial area
On October 8, 2022, at approximately 1045 hours, Officer L. Gutierrez and I were dispatched to the location regarding the reported incident.
I was operating the patrol vehicle with Officer L. Gutierrez in the passenger seat.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer in the driver's seat, contradicting the claim that Officer L. Gutierrez was in the passenger seat.

claims.claim_text: I activated my body-worn camera prior to arriving on scene.
Upon arrival at Trask Avenue near Magnolia Street, Westminster, CA, I observed the subject in the area matching the description provided by dispatch.
I was the primary officer and approached the subject first.
I identified myself verbally and directed the subject to stop.
The subject was cooperative during initial contact.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is seen walking away and not complying with initial commands to stop and sit down.

claims.claim_text: The lighting conditions were adequate for observation.
claims.evidence_observations: The lighting is very poor due to fog and darkness, contradicting adequate lighting conditions.

claims.claim_text: I gave clear verbal commands for the subject to comply with our instructions.
claims.evidence_observations: The officer's commands are repeated and urgent, suggesting they may not have been clear or effective.

claims.claim_text: The situation escalated when the subject failed to follow directives.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is seen walking away and continuing to walk, indicating failure to follow directives.

claims.claim_text: The subject made a sudden movement toward his waistband.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject is seen walking and then running, but there is no clear visual of a sudden movement toward the waistband in this clip. The subject is seen walking away and then running.

claims.claim_text: Officer L. Gutierrez was positioned to my right, approximately ten feet away.
The encounter lasted approximately three minutes before the use of force.
Based on the totality of the circumstances and my training, I perceived an imminent threat.
I discharged my firearm in response to an immediate threat.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject being tased and falling, but there is no clear visual of the officer discharging a firearm. The audio mentions 'I have a shot take it' but does not confirm a firearm discharge.

claims.claim_text: Medical aid was rendered immediately after the subject was secured.
Paramedics arrived within approximately five minutes.
Officer L. Gutierrez and I maintained scene security until investigative units arrived.
No bystanders were present in the immediate area during the incident.
All evidence was properly collected and secured at the scene.
The subject's weapon was recovered at the scene.
Body-worn camera footage
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows body-worn camera footage as stated in the transcript at 1:45-1:50.
